sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Identify the correct interjection to complete the sentence: '___! We have won the championship.'
In the poem 'Vocation', what does the child wish to become when he sees the gardener digging the soil?
Choose the correct preposition: The brave dog jumped ___ the high fence to catch the ball.
In the story 'The Decision of the Panchayat', who is traditionally considered the head of the village council?
Select the correct conjunction: He ran very fast, ___ he still missed the school bus.
Change into indirect speech: She said, 'I am very happy today.'
options: A) She said that she is very happy today.
B) She said that she was very happy that day.
C) She says that she was happy today.
D) She said I am happy that day.
questions.answer: B) She said that she was very happy that day.

questions.question_text: What is 'Gilli Danda' primarily played with?
options: A) A bat and a ball
C) A racket and a shuttlecock
A) The cat drank the milk.
B) The boy kicked the football.
C) The letter was written by her.
questions.answer: C) The letter was written by her.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct synonym for the word 'Enormous'.
Find the adverb in the sentence: 'The old man walked slowly across the crowded street.'

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Describe the main feature of the tank mentioned in the story 'What a Tank'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The tank was enormous, holding a vast amount of fresh water that supplied the entire village, serving as a central gathering place for everyone.

questions.question_text: Change this sentence into passive voice: 'The skilled artist painted a beautiful portrait.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A beautiful portrait was painted by the skilled artist. In the passive voice, the object is moved to the beginning to receive the action.

questions.question_text: Why does the child in the poem 'Vocation' want to be a watchman? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The child wants to be a watchman so he can walk the dark streets at night with a lantern and never be forced to sleep.

questions.question_text: Change this sentence to indirect speech: The teacher said to him, "You must work hard." [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The teacher advised him that he had to work hard. The direct instruction successfully changes to reported speech using the proper past tense.

questions.question_text: Write the antonym of 'Victory' and use it in a meaningful sentence. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The antonym is 'Defeat'. Sentence: The brave soldiers fought valiantly, proving that they would never accept defeat in the battlefield without a fight.

questions.question_text: How does the story 'The Decision of the Panchayat' show that justice is blind to personal relationships? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The story illustrates that when a person sits in the seat of judgment, they must forget personal friendships and enmities. They are bound by truth and fairness to deliver unbiased justice, showing that the law respects no personal ties.

questions.question_text: Imagine you visited the bangle makers in 'Glass Bangles'. Describe the working conditions and the beauty of the bangles they create. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The bangle makers work in hot, dark, and smoky rooms around blazing furnaces, facing great hardships. Despite these tough conditions, their skilled hands create sparkling, colorful glass bangles that bring immense joy and radiant beauty to the women who wear them.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Applied Composition

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph on the thrill of playing a traditional outdoor game like 'Gilli Danda' with your friends. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Playing Gilli Danda with friends is an exhilarating experience filled with laughter and running. Striking the small wooden gilli high into the air requires great focus and skill. The excitement of chasing it across the dusty ground builds strong teamwork and creates unforgettable childhood memories of wonderful outdoor fun.

questions.question_text: Write a short letter to your friend inviting them to spend the upcoming summer vacation at your village. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Dear Rohan, I hope you are doing well. I am writing to lovingly invite you to spend your summer vacation at my village this year. We can play outdoor games, swim in the cool river, and enjoy fresh mangoes from our orchards. I eagerly await your arrival. Your loving friend, Amit.
